title: Ranges Pipeline
hints: A pipeline reads left to right: v | std::views::filter(is_even) | std::views::transform(square) | std::views::take(limit). Nothing runs until you loop over it.
C++20 has no std::ranges::to (that is C++23). Fill the result with a range-for loop and push_back, or std::ranges::copy(view, std::back_inserter(out)).
sum_while_positive: std::views::take_while. first_n_multiples: std::views::iota(1) is the infinite sequence 1, 2, 3, ... - take(n) makes it finite.
sort_by_length: std::ranges::sort(words) for the alphabetical order, then std::ranges::stable_sort(words, {}, projection) where the projection returns the length. has_long_word: std::ranges::any_of.
